item.title: ₹213.24 Cr Ropeway Connecting Kamakhya Station to Temple Approved, Travel Time Cut to 6 Minutes
item.description: GUWAHATI: Assam is set to get a major boost in its pilgrimage infrastructure as the Union Government has approved a ₹213.24 crore ropeway project connecting Kamakhya Railway Station to the Maa Kamakhya Temple. The project, announced by Union Minister of Road Transport and Highways Nitin Gadkari, is expected to enhance accessibility for devotees and strengthen Assam’s tourism landscape. item.title: Indian Rupee Nears ₹92 as Markets Face Sustained Pressure
item.description: GUWAHATI: The Indian rupee fell to a record low on Friday, January 23, and posted its steepest weekly decline in six months, weighed down by sustained foreign fund outflows and heightened hedging by importers. The currency slipped to ₹91.9650 per dollar, narrowly missing the ₹92 level, before settling at ₹91.94, down 0.34% on the day. item.title: Assam Government Prohibits Strikes in Oil and Gas Sector for Six Months
item.description: GUWAHATI: The Assam Government has prohibited strikes in the oil and gas sector for a period of six months, invoking Section (3) of the Essential Services Maintenance (Assam) Act, 1980, according to an official notification issued on Thursday, January 27. The Act aims to ensure the maintenance of certain essential services and the normal life of community in Assam. item.title: Heroin Worth ₹2 Crore Seized in Assam’s Karbi Anglong; Two Arrested
item.description: GUWAHATI: Assam Police recently seized heroin worth ₹2 crore in Karbi Anglong district. ALSO READ: Will PM Modi Land on a National Highway in Moran During His Likely Assam Visit in February? The operation led to the recovery of 30 boxes of heroin, following which two individuals were apprehended, the police confirmed. Chief Minister Himanta Biswa Sarma, sharing details on X, said the police intercepted a “travelling soap factory… minus the soap”, highlighting the unusual mode of drug transport.

item.title: Picnic Culture Turns Guwahati’s Basistha Temple into Dumping Ground
item.description: Despite dustbins, warnings, and daily cleaning litter continues to choke the sacred grounds of Basistha Temple.
